_comment: N1081B .243 Section B module config per HV scan, keyed by scan tag (the first '_'-delimited token of each sub-run name in run_config_beam.py / the active run_config_beam.json). The watcher (n1081b/n1081b_scan_watcher.py) applies 'delay' to both input channels and 'output_status' to both output channels, preserving every other field (gate, monostable width, inversion) read live from the board. 'delay' is the raw N1081B input-delay field; baseline (current) = 1000, treated as ns; values are baseline 1000 +/- the requested ns shift.

baseline._note: current config; restored on run completion

ctrl._note: no-trigger baseline: output ON, input OFF (holds trigger line at its normal 3V idle, no pulses). Inserted 2026-07-05 as the cleaner replacement for scan01's output-OFF control.
